# Exercise 5 answer script
# Expected output variables:
# scores, dept_avg, quarter_avg, best_dept, dept_factor

# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK START =====
if (!exists("scores")) {
  scores <- matrix(
    c(
      88, 92, 79, 85,
      75, 81, 69, 74,
      91, 95, 89, 93
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
}
# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK END =====

# ===== YOUR SOLUTION START =====
rownames(scores) <- c("IT", "HR", "Sales")
colnames(scores) <- paste0("Q", 1:4)
dept_avg <- rowMeans(scores)
quarter_avg <- colMeans(scores)
best_dept <- names(which.max(dept_avg))
dept_factor <- factor(rownames(scores))
# ===== YOUR SOLUTION END =====
